notes: Add a persistent Use this drive switch to every mapped drive under Settings → Nodes & drives.
Mark switched-off drives as Do not use on the dashboard while keeping them visible and retaining tray controls.
Block manual starts, queued intake, retries and automatic starts for drives marked Do not use.
Cancel any waiting-for-disc intake when a drive is switched off, without interrupting an already-running rip.
